com.zynthec.zLoader.name: zLoader
com.zynthec.zLoader.subtitle: Independent SideStore fork for iPhone and iPad.
com.zynthec.zLoader.localizedDescription: Sideloading and manage apps, deveoloper profiles and much more in zynthec style.
com.zynthec.zLoader.versionDescription: Remaining days use the earliest expiry of the host profile, installed extension profiles and known signing certificate. Refresh uses the correct host profile instead of an arbitrary extension; cellular batch refresh now persists renewed expiry dates. A new self-update no longer restores stale dates from the previous build.
